name: Friends 2 ~Child Fruit~
source:
Sayaka sneaks into her uncle's room at night and starts to cry and kiss. Her sister witnesses the scene and approaches as well. Two elementary school students love their uncle. How long will this punishment last?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
沙耶香晚上偷偷溜进叔叔的房间，开始哭泣和亲吻。她的妹妹目睹了这一幕，也走了过来。两个小学生都很爱他们的叔叔。这种惩罚会持续多久？
